loadingImpact: Accessible label of the progress bar while the "Your impact" module loads.
activeDiscussionFilters: Accessible label of the row of filter buttons above the active discussions cards.
commentCount: Supporting line on an active discussion card. $1 = number of comments in the discussion.
loadingBornOnThisDay: Accessible label of the progress bar while the "Born on this day" module ({{msg|modules-bornOnThisDay}}) loads.
loadingDidYouKnow: Accessible label of the progress bar while the "Did you know" module ({{msg|modules-didYouKnow}}) loads.
loadingFeatured: Accessible label of the progress bar while the featured article module loads.
flagFirstEdit: Chip on a recent change card: the edit is the first one made by its author.
flagNewEditor: Chip on a recent change card: the edit was made by a newcomer.
flagNeedsReference: Chip on a recent change card: the edit adds content whose references should be checked.
flagToneIssue: Chip on a recent change card: the edit may not be written in a neutral, encyclopedic tone.
flagHighRevertRisk: Chip on a recent change card: a model predicts the edit is likely to be reverted.
chipLatest: Chip on a recent change card: this is the latest edit (revision) of the page. French: refers to "modification" (feminine).
chipReverted: Chip on a recent change card: the edit has been reverted. French: refers to "modification" (feminine).
chipMajorChange: Chip on a recent change card: the edit changed a large part of the page.
reviewMoreChanges: Button/link under the review changes module that shows more recent changes.
loadingFurtherReading: Accessible label of the progress bar while the reading suggestions ({{msg|modules-furtherReading}}) load.
savedJustNow: Supporting line on a saved page card, saved less than a minute ago.
savedMinutesAgo: Supporting line on a saved page card. $1 = number of minutes (1–59). Keep it short (abbreviated unit).
savedHoursAgo: Supporting line on a saved page card. $1 = number of hours (1–23). Keep it short (abbreviated unit).
savedDaysAgo: Supporting line on a saved page card. $1 = number of days. Keep it short (abbreviated unit).
savedEmpty: Empty state of the Saved module. $1 = the bookmark (save) icon, rendered inline as an image; keep it right after the words for "save icon".
loadingTrending: Accessible label of the progress bar while the trending module ({{msg|modules-trending}}) loads.
